DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Distal) or Midgut Volvulus.

Given the history of bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, and failure to thrive in an 8-month-old, along with the lack of stool passage noted in our findings, I am strongly suspecting a distal intestinal obstruction such as jejunal or ileal atresia, or a midgut volvulus. The absence of gas in the rectum further supports a complete or near-complete distal obstruction. Please prepare the infant for immediate surgical consultation and exploratory laparotomy to confirm the diagnosis and relieve the obstruction.
